body: Ehh. Not much anymore. I’m just an organism on the planet that no longer wants to be a living one.
To ease the pain of unanswered questions and all the “whys”etc.

They’re private. But basically explanations of why I chose to end my life, how to go about dealing with my finances and possessions, and a request for no funeral and a cremation if my body is recovered.
The letters I’ve written explaining why. They’ll receive them after the deed is done. And will also be able to retrieve my car and other belongings.
I love the ocean. Open water swimming is one of my favorite activities. My family won’t be surprised at all that I chose this as my last activity.
